groups.name: spring-console
groups.description: Interactive Kotlin REPL and MCP server for the running application.

properties.name: spring-console.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for the whole console.

properties.name: spring-console.default-rollback
properties.description: Default for eval's rollback flag when the caller does not specify one.

properties.name: spring-console.eval-timeout-ms
properties.description: Default user-code evaluation timeout in milliseconds, overridable per eval call.

properties.name: spring-console.warmup
properties.description: Pre-initialize the script compiler in a background thread at startup.

properties.name: spring-console.include-infrastructure-beans
properties.description: Also bind Spring's internal beans (names under org.springframework.) into the REPL scope.

properties.name: spring-console.default-imports
properties.description: Imports added to every snippet, e.g. com.example.domain.*.

properties.name: spring-console.mcp.enabled
properties.description: Expose the MCP server over HTTP.

properties.name: spring-console.mcp.host
properties.description: Interface to bind. Local-only by default; the console executes arbitrary code.

properties.name: spring-console.mcp.port
properties.description: MCP server port. 0 picks an ephemeral port.

properties.name: spring-console.mcp.path
properties.description: URL path of the JSON-RPC endpoint.

properties.name: spring-console.mcp.stdio
properties.description: Serve MCP over stdin/stdout instead of HTTP; disables the terminal REPL.

properties.name: spring-console.repl.enabled
properties.description: Start the interactive terminal REPL when a usable terminal is attached.

properties.name: spring-console.reload.enabled
properties.description: Allow reload to recompile and restart the application context.

properties.name: spring-console.reload.command
properties.description: Build command for incremental recompilation. Auto-detected from gradlew/mvnw when empty.

properties.name: spring-console.reload.project-dir
properties.description: Root of the project's build; defaults to the process working directory.

properties.name: spring-console.reload.compile-timeout-ms
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for the build tool.

properties.name: spring-console.reload.restart-timeout-ms
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for the restarted context to come up.
